newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee at session's peak, Sept above $1,600.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee at session's peak, Sept above $1,600.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures were traded quietly higher towards Thursday midsession as the market found some follow-through buying on the back of New York's rally on Wednesday.
Benchmark September, regaining a foothold above the $1,600 mark for the first time in three days, finished midday $55 higher at $1,615 per tonne after a session high of $1,617.
It had gapped $30 up at $1,590. Traders had called the market to open $130 up on numbers and $40-$50 up in practice.

New York's arabica futures jumped sharply for the second day in a row on Wednesday as speculators continued to buy heavily in anticipation of a shortage of exchange-certified coffee for delivery against September.

Traders said the outlook for London could gradually improve if New York's rally maintains its momentum. The September contract could challenge a key hurdle at 188 cents a lb if the initial 184.50 resistance is taken out.
Robustas need to break out of its tightening $1,545-$1,610 band basis September before attempting further upside move.
"We have seen a bottom. But until we get above $1,700, we can't talk of a bullish move yet," one trader said.
